raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 144 duplicated txn_id values in raw_transactions are exact copies in every column, including batch_id and ingest_ts, so they are redelivered rows rather than distinct transactions. Silver keeps every copy, and the gold aggregates double-count them. Deduplicating on txn_id in silver_transactions removes the copies, and the gold tables rebuild from the corrected silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.82, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT DISTINCT ON (txn_id) CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' ORDER BY txn_id;"}}
